name: Lakshadweep

topAttractions.name: Minicoy Island
topAttractions.description: A coral island known for its beautiful beaches, crystal-clear lagoons, and a unique culture influenced by the Maldivian and Indian traditions.

topAttractions.name: Kavaratti Island
topAttractions.description: The administrative capital of Lakshadweep, known for its beautiful beaches, coral reefs, and the famous Kavaratti Beach.

topAttractions.name: Bangaram Island
topAttractions.description: A picturesque island with pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and a coral reef perfect for snorkeling and diving.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Lakshadweep is from October to May, when the weather is pleasant and the sea is calm, making it ideal for water sports and activities.
culturalFact: Lakshadweep is home to the traditional 'Kalakari' craft, a unique form of handloom weaving that is a Geographical Indication (GI) tagged craft of the Union Territory.

hiddenGem.name: The Lakshadweep Museum
hiddenGem.description: A museum located in Kavaratti that showcases the history, culture, and marine life of the islands.

relatedFestival: The Lakshadweep Islands celebrate the Eid-al-Fitr festival with great fervor, showcasing the unique blend of Islamic and Indian traditions.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, you might be interested in visiting Lakshadweep, which shares a similar tropical island experience and rich marine biodiversity.
